Manifest.Name: 模组守卫 / Mod Guard
Manifest.Author: fjwjmmc
Manifest.Description: 阻止启用名单上已确认恶意的工坊条目，并对可疑条目发出警告。它不是杀毒软件：只认识名单上的条目，没有警告不代表安全。Blocks activating Workshop items listed as malicious and warns about suspicious ones. It is not an antivirus: it only knows what is on its list, and no warning does not mean a mod is safe.
